content.short: Institutional yield platform for stablecoins that ran Stable's $1.8B pre-deposit vault.
content.description: Hourglass connects stablecoin holders to institutional yield strategies through on-chain vaults with KYC. It ran the pre-deposit campaign for Stable's mainnet, taking USDC on Ethereum ahead of launch as pre-iUSDT. The second phase of that campaign closed with $1.8 billion from more than 25,000 wallets, with one wallet allowed per verified user.
content.meta: Hourglass runs KYC'd institutional stablecoin yield vaults and hosted Stable's pre-deposit campaign, which raised $1.8B.
